stops.title: Di Paiplain
stops.caption: Fo sɛshɔn, dɛn wan dipatmɛnt.
stops.speech: Nyu Biliva na di disaypulship trak. Fo sɛshɔn, dɛn jɔyn wan dipatmɛnt, wit ɛvri pɔsin we yu kin si pan di bɔd.

stops.title: Sɛshɔn dɛn
stops.caption: Skɛjul, tich ɛn rɛjista.
stops.speech: Dɛn de skɛjul sɛshɔn pɛ branch wit ticha ɛn de. Tek di rɛjista insay di sɛshɔn, dɛn muv pipul go di nɛks stej.
